❓ Frequently asked questions

How do tel: links work?

tel: links tell mobile devices to open the phone dialer with the number pre-filled. On desktops they open the default calling app (e.g. Skype, FaceTime).

Do I need to format the number myself?

The number is normalized to E.164-style digits with a leading +, so it dials correctly from any country.

What about phone extensions?

Enter it in the extension field and the tool appends ;ext=123, which dialers understand.

Is this private?

Yes — everything is done locally in your browser.
